items.title: perf(id): adopt cargo-nextest for pkgs/id test recipes (#6378)
items.body: ## Summary Adopts cargo-nextest for the pkgs/id test suite (issue #6378, queue task 14371). cargo-nextest was already in the dev shell and in every nix check derivation (`pkgs/id/nix-common.nix` lists it in `nativeBuildInputs`, inherited by `pkgs/id/flake.nix`'s `mkCheckWith`), but no test invocation used it. The PR gate already shards the integration suite by test target (test-shard-0..3, #869/#551); this change adds per-test process parallelism inside each shard and a shared nextest config. ## Changes - `pkgs/id/.config/nextest.toml` (new): fail-fast off, no retries, `test-threads = "num-cpus"`, slow-test marking at 60s (no termination), `ci` profile with junit output. - `pkgs/id/justfile`: `test-rust`, `test-sandbox`, `test-full`, `test-unit`, `test-native-shell`, `test-integration`, `test-int-sandbox`, `test-verbose`, `test-one` now run `cargo nextest run`. Recipe names/params/deps unchanged. - `pkgs/id/scripts/test-shard-sandbox.sh`: shard commands run nextest; the existing 4-way target sharding is unchanged. - `pkgs/id/just-recipes.json`: regenerated — it had drifted on main (`planted-bug-check` recipe missing) and the recorded recipe bodies now match the justfile. The machine-specific `source` path was restored to the previously committed value (the drift check projects it out). ## Coverage preservation - nextest never runs doc tests, so `test-rust` and shard 0 keep an explicit `cargo test --doc` step. - The sandbox `serve_tests` skip is reproduced as `-E 'not test(serve_tests)'`. - Crash-gate recipes keep `cargo test`: they rely on `--include-ignored` name-filter semantics. - No test is deleted or newly skipped. ## Verification - `cargo nextest run --all-features --lib` in this worktree: **3467 passed, 1 failed, 15 skipped (pre-existing `#[ignore]`)** of 3468 tests in 132s. The one failure, `web::tests::test_load_asset_urls_from_manifest`, is an environment artifact of the local stub `web/dist` (see below): the identical test fails under plain `cargo test` with the same stub, and after building the real web assets (`bun install` + `bun run build`, as the nix checks do) all 9 `web::tests` pass under nextest, including that test. Oracle: the full pkgs/id lib suite under the new runner, with any failure reproduced under the old runner before it counts as a regression. - Filter syntax (`not test(serve_tests)`, `test(name)`) verified on a probe crate against nextest 0.9.146 before use; the committed `.config/nextest.toml` (including the `ci` profile) parses and runs there. - `bash scripts/just-recipes-check.sh`: passes (failed on clean main before this change due to the pre-existing drift above). - `bash -n scripts/test-shard-sandbox.sh`: OK. - Pre-existing, unrelated: a bare `cargo test --all-features --lib` outside the nix shell fails on this tree (and on clean main) because `--all-features` enables the `web` feature whose RustEmbed `web/dist` folder is a bun build artifact; the nix check derivations build it first (`(cd web && bun run build)` in `mkCheckWith`). A stub `web/dist/index.html` (gitignored) was used for the first local nextest run above; the real assets were then built locally to disposition the one stub-caused failure (see the verification bullet). Refs #6378 --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.

items.title: fix(aggregator): isDnsSection rejects negative DNS money (#4226)
items.body: ## What `isDnsSection` (`pm-stack/aggregator/src/dns.ts`) was hardened by #2412 to require finite `totalAnnualListUsd` / entry `priceUsd`, but neither money field was bounded below — a negative finite total or entry price passed the gate, rendered as negative spend (`$-999.00` rows, negative `/yr` total), and was appended to snapshot records. This PR adds the lower bound: - `totalAnnualListUsd >= 0` in `isDnsSection` - present `priceUsd >= 0` (null/absent stays valid, unchanged) ## Tests New regression test beside the #2412 cases in `pm-stack/aggregator/test/slice3.test.ts` ("isDnsSection rejects negative money, allows zero (#4226)"): negative total (-999, -0.01) rejected, negative entry price rejected, zero total / zero price / null price controls stay valid. - Targeted: `bun test test/slice3.test.ts` — 32/32 pass. - Full aggregator suite: 1161 pass; `test/brief-surfaces.test.ts` failure is pre-existing on clean main (verified by stashing this change: same 1 fail) and unrelated to dns.ts. Queue task 6378 · Closes #4226 --- Open in [code]smith · Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need.
